notes.title: About development process of game
notes.content:
Hello Dear Players,

  As some of you know, I have been receiving treatment for the last five months.I have a genetic disease.So I can't develop the game.My treatment is going well.Only one vital organ has been damaged.My treatment is underway,but I still have the possibility of cancer.I'm waiting for the final test results.I am determined to continue developing the game no matter what the test result is.I am currently preparing a document about the development process of the game.From there you'll know the entire development process of the game.I will change a few things in the game.I'm going to work less time, I have to go to the radical changes in the game.
   After I get the test results, I will prepare the development list again and share it with you.I'm so sorry about this.I know that you paid and bought this game and you are expecting a development.

Best Wishes,
Arda Süer Özçelik

notes.title: Early Access Version 0.3 released.
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30431870/3531f1d2ac68a1c7a19f9295187b3b0bc71baa01.jpg[/img]
Hello everyone,

  Early access V0.3 update is released.If find a bug please send a mail(suerozcelik@gmail or suerozcelik@pocketuniversegame.com).

 [b] Soundtracks and sounds[/b]
[list]
[*]Twenty soundtracks have been added to the game.
[*]Soundtracks belong to [b]Ender Güney[/b].
[*]Several surround sounds were added.
[/list]
[b] Optimization[/b]
[list]
[*]I edited and optimized all the software files except artificial intelligence.Because artificial intelligence software is a very large file, I will fix it in future updates.
[*]The entrance scene of the game was deleted because it caused a lot of problems in the opening of the game.
[/list]
[b]Graphics[/b]
[list]
[*]The graphics quality was improved in a software.
[*]Very long and effective studies have been done on the light.
[*]Reflection settings were made.
[*]Some texture map updates were made.
[*]A new water model was added.
[*]New terrain textures added.
[*]Tessellation technology was added.
[/list]
[b]AI[/b]
[list]
[*]Artificial intelligence is a little more intelligent.
[*]Passing through character has been fixed.

notes.title: About graphic and software improve
notes.content:

As alpha v0.3 continues to work, I keep you informed of improvements.I continue to develop our graphical software and shader software.I made changes in game software, especially times.The duration of a day was reduced from 60 minutes to 22 minutes.The construction times and production times have also decreased accordingly.You can see graphical changes in the images.

notes.title: Early Access Version 0.2c update,Mac and Linux support released.
notes.content:
Early Access Version 0.2c update and Mac,Linux support

Hello Everyone,

Explanation of the delay;

First of all I apologize for the delay,I had a very busy year end.We had to carry an office with the contract's completion.And we've had a few bureaucratic problems.Finally, because of the need for mac and linux support, I have struggled with this problem.For this reason, version 0.3 is delayed.

What came with this patch?


[list]
    [*]Mac and Linux support.
    [*]Software optimization(This update largely removed the fps problem.).
    [*]Several audio files have been added
    [*]A few problematic files have been fixed.
    [*]Artificial intelligence update.
[/list]

notes.title: About release date and changes.
notes.content:
Hello,
My name is Arda,I'm game developer of Pocket Universe.First of all thank you for your interest in us.We receive a lot of mail every day.We are followers and our wishlist is growing day by day.
We set our release date to 5 October 2017.There were changes of Pocket Universe.
-Controller;
We are change player controller.Now use third person controller.

-Project file crashes and new map;
Unfortunately our project file has collapsed.We have not recovered any graphics files.So we made a new map.This map is 16 times bigger than the previous one.Other than that, there will be no other functions in the first update.But because we have saved our software files. In a very short time the game will be faction specific.Our idea is to bring an update every fifteen days.

Arda Süer Özçelik
Core Steel Game Studio
